title: Checkout Responsiveness & Usability
description: The retail checkout workflow must be fast, intuitive, and easy for shoppers across devices without delays.
project_context: Online storefront serving authenticated shoppers. No target latency, device matrix, or usability benchmark has been agreed.
review_expectations: Identify 'fast', 'intuitive', 'easy', and 'across devices' as subjective or unmeasured.
Ask direct clarification questions for concrete latency percentiles, device viewport targets, and usability metrics.
Do not treat unconfirmed AI latency targets as stakeholder-approved SLAs.

title: Timely Workspace Notification Delivery
description: Stakeholders should receive timely notifications whenever important workspace events happen.
project_context: Collaborative requirements and quality review platform. Notification channels and retention rules are undecided.
review_expectations: Flag 'timely' and 'important workspace events' as ambiguous.
Clarify exact triggering events, delivery channels, and privacy/compliance constraints.
Preserve ambiguity until stakeholders choose concrete event triggers.

title: Graceful Inactive Session Handling
description: Idle user sessions should remain open for a reasonable period before signing out safely.
project_context: Web workspace using cookie-token authentication. Timeout durations and security policy remain undecided.
review_expectations: Flag 'reasonable period' and 'safely' as ambiguous.
Ask for exact inactivity timeout duration and transport security requirements.
Flag any unconfirmed timeout or protocol numbers introduced by AI.

title: Document Search Under Load
description: Users can search stored project requirements by keyword, and the search endpoint must handle concurrent usage gracefully.
project_context: Requirements repository search feature. Concurrent user count, response-time percentile, and pagination caps are unspecified.
review_expectations: Identify missing load target, missing response-time threshold, and unspecified behavior when queries match zero results or exceed timeouts.
Produce clarification questions without silently confirming invented capacity limits.

title: Audit Log Export Filtering
description: Administrators can export filtered workspace activity logs for external compliance review.
project_context: Organization Admin console with audit_events tracking. Export file formats, date-range filters, and row limits are not specified.
review_expectations: Identify missing export file formats, timezone convention, filter criteria, and empty-result behavior.
Keep unresolved format and row-limit decisions marked for stakeholder confirmation.

title: Failed Sign-In Account Protection
description: The authentication service must protect user accounts against repeated failed sign-in attempts.
project_context: Public login endpoint. Retry threshold, window duration, cooldown period, and admin unlock policy are not yet specified.
review_expectations: Ask for exact retry limits, observation window, cooldown behavior, and HTTP response codes.
Do not invent unstated lockout counts or window durations as confirmed requirements.

title: Approved Transfer Email Notifications
description: Send a confirmation email for every approved fund transfer. Never send emails for approved transfers.
project_context: Both statements come from stakeholders of equal authority and no precedence policy has been recorded.
review_expectations: Record the direct contradiction in conflict_issues without picking one rule over the other.
Retain [TO BE CONFIRMED: ...] in improved_requirement and keep dependent scenarios BLOCKED pending clarification.

title: Report Deletion vs. Immutable Audit Trail
description: Managers can permanently delete historical review reports at any time. Every review report must remain permanently immutable and non-deletable for auditing.
project_context: Operations and compliance teams submitted conflicting lifecycle requirements with no formal override decision.
review_expectations: Highlight the mutability/deletion conflict in conflict_issues.
Avoid choosing either deletion or permanent retention; block dependent test scenarios until resolved.

title: Password Length & Invitation Expiry Bounds
description: User passwords must contain minimum 12 and maximum 128 characters. User invitations expire in 24 hours, apply a 15 minutes temporary lock after at most 5 failed email verification attempts, and password reset tokens remain valid for 1 hour.
project_context: Invitation onboarding and password recovery flows.
review_expectations: Preserve minimum 12, maximum 128, 24 hours, 15 minutes, at most 5, and 1 hour accurately.
Generate positive, negative, and boundary test scenarios targeting those exact thresholds.

title: Shipment Status API Load & Latency SLA
description: Under 200 users simultaneously authenticated, 95% of shipment-status API requests must complete within 2 seconds during a 30 minutes load test with response payloads of at most 500 kb.
project_context: Production telemetry endpoint queried by authenticated logistics clients.
review_expectations: Preserve 200 users, 95%, 2 seconds, 30 minutes, and 500 kb without inflating or inventing extra SLAs.
Avoid triggering false value_safety warnings on supplied measurements.

title: Archive Library Catalogue Record
description: A librarian can archive an active book catalog record. Archived book records remain visible to authenticated librarians and are excluded from public reader search results.
project_context: Library catalog service distinguishing librarian staff from unauthenticated public readers.
review_expectations: Preserve librarian actor, retained librarian visibility, and public search exclusion cleanly.
Produce direct Positive and Negative scenarios without inventing deletion timers or approval chains.

title: Role-Based Requirement Export Authorization
description: Only authenticated SQA Engineers with active project access can download requirement PDF and CSV exports. Authenticated Analysts receive HTTP 403 Forbidden and unauthenticated guests receive HTTP 401 Unauthorized.
project_context: ReqQuality AI export endpoints enforcing role-based authorization boundaries.
review_expectations: Preserve allowed role (SQA Engineer with active project access) and denied roles/status codes (Analyst 403, guest 401).
Do not invent extra MFA or encryption requirements.
